lan_id.description: The identifier for the LAN you want to create an ACL policy with.

lan_name.description: The name of the LAN based on the provided lan_id.

ports.description: Array of ports on the provided LAN that will be included in the ACL. If no ports are provided, communication on any port on this LAN is allowed.

subnets.description: Array of subnet IPs within the LAN that will be included in the ACL. If no subnets are provided, communication on any subnets on this LAN are allowed.
